description: Responsible for high-level engine architecture, data-oriented design patterns, and ensuring all subsystems (ECS, Rendering, Physics) integrate cohesively without violating core performance constraints.
responsibilities: Design memory layouts for massive entity counts
Define interfaces between the ECS core and rendering/physics systems
Ensure Dart 3 features (Records, Patterns, Extension Types) are leveraged for zero-cost abstractions
Review technical implementations to ensure compliance with the zero-allocation-per-frame rule
context: Sting is a bare-metal 2D engine. The architect must heavily prioritize cache locality and flat data structures (Float32List, Int32List) over traditional OOP hierarchies.
